judgments.rationale: Subparagraph (B) provides an incoming governing condition specifically limiting the application of subparagraph (A) to consumer reporting agencies described in section 1681a(p) only if the consumer's request is made using the centralized source established under section 211(c) of the Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act of 2003. Proposal P0000 correctly incorporates this governing qualification into the summary for independent use and cites the corresponding source context quote.

Proposal P0001 incorrectly extends the centralized source condition to agencies described in section 1681a(w). Subparagraph (B) explicitly applies the centralized source condition only to consumer reporting agencies described in section 1681a(p).

The unchanged draft reading for C0000 omits the governing incoming qualification in subparagraph (B), which restricts the duty of section 1681a(p) agencies under subparagraph (A) to requests made via the centralized source. Leaving C0000 without this governing qualification leaves the reading incomplete for independent use.

source_spans.quote:
All consumer reporting agencies described in subsections (p) and (w) 1

1 See References in Text note below.

 of section 1681a of this title shall make all disclosures pursuant to section 1681g of this title once during any 12-month period upon request of the consumer and without charge to the consumer.

Subparagraph (A) shall apply with respect to a consumer reporting agency described in section 1681a(p) of this title only if the request from the consumer is made using the centralized source established for such purpose in accordance with section 211(c) 1 of the Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act of 2003.
